APPEAL filed under Clause 15 of the Letters Patent to set aside the final order dated 31.10.2025 passed in WP. No. 40623 of 2025.

The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— Ms. C. Anbu Mozhi, learned counsel on record for the appellant seeks withdrawal of this Writ Appeal and also makes an endorsement to this effect.

2. Recording the endorsement made, this Writ Appeal and the connected Miscellaneous Petition are dismissed as withdrawn. No costs.
